data.name: Pixel Sketch
data.detailed_description:
Battle of Painters é o primeiro jogo online onde você tem que competir com outros jogadores em um desenho!

A rodada começa e você recebe um tema, o objetivo é fazer um desenho baseado no tema dado em 5 minutos usando um monte de ferramentas como lápis, borracha, spray, formas quadradas e circulares, linha, bomba (apaga tudo), Desfazer e refazer ferramentas. Mas você não está sozinho: outros jogadores estão desenhando suas pinturas na sua frente! Há uma votação para a melhor foto depois que a rodada acabou. A pintura com mais votos ganha o jogo!

- 2 modos de jogo: Battle of Painters e Draw & Ginky, também conhecido como Charades
- Galeria on-line
- Sistema de amigos
- Personalização do jogador

reviews.review:
Pixel Sketch is a really simple multiplayer drawing game, but I found the basic idea surprisingly enjoyable. I am given a theme and have to create a drawing while other players are working on their own pictures at the same time. I liked how quickly the game gets to the point because there is no complicated setup between rounds.

The drawing tools are straightforward, which is probably the right decision for this kind of game. I can focus on turning the theme into something recognizable rather than spending time learning a complicated art program. The time pressure also makes things more interesting because I have to commit to an idea and work with whatever I can create before the round ends.

The best part is seeing what everyone else comes up with. Once the drawings are finished, the players vote on the results, which gives every round a clear sense of competition. I enjoyed the fact that artistic skill is not the only thing that matters because clever ideas and funny interpretations can also make a drawing memorable.

The world gallery is another nice addition because it gives the art created during matches somewhere to live after the round. I like the idea of browsing through other people's pixel art and seeing the different ways people interpret similar themes. The friends system and voice chat also make the game feel more like a social activity than a simple drawing application.

My biggest issue is that the game depends heavily on having other people around. Drawing by myself is obviously not the main point, and the voting system only really works when there is an active group taking part. That can make the experience feel much less exciting when there are not enough players available.

The presentation is intentionally minimalist, which I think suits it well. I do not need flashy graphics when the whole point is creating the pictures myself. At the same time, the simplicity means there is not much progression outside of improving my own drawing skills and enjoying the social side of the matches.

Overall, Pixel Sketch is a charming little online drawing game that I enjoyed mainly because of its competitive social atmosphere. I liked the time pressure, simple tools and the voting system, while the gallery gives the artwork some lasting value. It is very dependent on having other people to play with, but when the group is there, it can be a lot of fun.

Rating: 7.3/10
